# member-chain: property and method chains that stand alone as a value, without a call group.
# the syntax exemption reads two or more identifier segments joined by `.`, `?.`, `::` or `->`,
# where every segment reads as words and at most one short segment of eight bytes or fewer does
# not. a `$0` closure parameter or a `.0` tuple field counts as a segment without a name.
# known gap: a segment carrying an upper-case acronym inside a lower-case word, such as
# `surfaceConfigDPI`, does not read as words, so `RendererApp.shared.surfaceConfigDPI?.size` is
# still reported.
